banned: Where the three readings converge, they converge without having been made to, because none of them was permitted to lean on the others.
required: So a reader who grants only one of the three canons can check that volume on its own terms and owes nothing to the other two. The convergence is one author's finding reproduced on three disjoint bodies of evidence under that constraint, and it is offered as exactly that, a reproduction under a stated constraint, never as three independent witnesses. The scriptures are the witnesses, each on its own ground.
